purpose: Centralize Go/Zen wiring in a Catalog registry, extract RequestFactory, and split long methods/helpers with no intended behavior change.
riskRationale: ~1092-line refactor across 12 files; tests/phpcs pass but subtle behavior deltas exist (header identity check, hashing canonicalization, fail-fast throws, @since/version drift).

text: Well-structured maintainability refactor: single owners for catalog maps, request construction, header policy, and MIME/JSON rules. Fallback review found no credential-handling regressions, but two important issues (version/@since drift, Go-only header identity check) plus several minors warrant fixes before merge.

reasoning: All four specialist subagents (security, performance, quality, logic) failed to dispatch (provider error: free tier only usable from within OpenCode), so a fallback single-pass direct file review was used. It found 2 important issues (version drift, subclass-fragile header check) and minor correctness/robustness nits; all are small and auto-fixable.

message: Key-change bust closure stays credential-blind (transient deletes only, never reads connectors_ai_* values), preserving the wp.org hard rule.
Availability policy preserved exactly (2xx true, 429 true, 401+CreditsError true, else false) and extracted into a directly testable classify_response.
Show-all flag isolated in resolve_show_all_models with non-array guard and test seam, keeping parsing helpers pure and fixing the old direct array-access on possibly-corrupt options.

New code uses @since 0.1.5 throughout (Catalog, RequestFactory, helpers) while plugin Version header, VERSION const, and readme.txt Stable tag remain 0.1.4, violating the repo hard rule to keep versions in sync.
suggestion: Either bump Version/VERSION/Stable tag + changelog to 0.1.5 or retag new APIs to 0.1.4.

message: should_send_for uses strict identity (OpenCodeGoProvider::class === $provider_class), so any subclassed/extended Go provider or test double silently omits the required x-opencode-session header and gets 400 MissingSessionID. Old probe always sent the header (Zen ignored it), so this is a behavior change for subclasses.
suggestion: Accept subclasses via is_a with string comparison.

message: transient_key() concatenates without require_valid(), unlike provider_class/directory_class/model_class, so a future caller passing unsanitized input can forge arbitrary opencode_connector_avail_* keys (cache-key injection/orphaning).

probe_request() is built outside the try/catch that guards authenticate/send, so if URL building or header injection throws, the stampede lock acquired on line 74 is never cleared via store_result(), causing 10s of false-negative isConfigured() results.
suggestion: Move probe construction inside try or clear the lock in a finally block.

message: mime_to_extension() falls back to 'png' for allowlisted-but-unmapped types, so adding a MIME to ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES without updating EXTENSIONS silently saves with the wrong extension instead of failing loudly and drifting from the advertised outputMimeType list.
suggestion: Derive extensions from a single map or throw on unmapped allowlisted types.

message: canonicalize_value() recursively copies and ksorts every array content payload on the hot chat/completions path; for large multimodal content blocks this adds per-request allocation/CPU with no size guard, where previously only a flat json_encode ran.
suggestion: Only canonicalize small maps or skip sorting for sequential lists via array_is_list() fast path.

message: createModelMetadataDirectory() and model_class_for() now throw InvalidArgumentException for unknown catalogs via Catalog fallback, where the old go-ternary silently defaulted everything non-go to Zen. Fail-fast is arguably correct but is a behavior change callers may not catch.
suggestion: Document the throw in docblocks or retain explicit Zen-default with a deprecation note if BC is required.

message: for_provider() calls $provider_class::url() with no class_exists/method_exists guard, so a bad class_map override fatals with Error instead of a catchable InvalidArgumentException.
suggestion: Validate the provider class before static call.
